title: DrawTalk Harness
Local and global edits to behaviors it learned
Built today · MongoDB Atlas + Vector Search · no preset motions
end: Every change it makes to itself is a MongoDB document
segments: Characters are drawn as vector ink. The behavior library starts EMPTY.
"the rabbit and the turtle race towards the rock"
The LLM writes two NEW behaviors: dash (rabbit) and plod (turtle)
Speed comes from each character's nature: quick rabbit, slow turtle
GLOBAL edit: "the turtle should move more slowly"
The harness proposes plod v2: a diff plus a regression replay of every clip
Its scope guess is shown and overridable: "All" saves plod v2 everywhere
Scene 2 continues from scene 1. A gesture + "the rabbit sleeps"...
...teaches nap and saves the gesture as a drawn word
A drawn path: "while the turtle plods through towards the tree"
plod v2 is reused along the path, in parallel with the nap
LOCAL edit: "the turtle should move faster this time"
"Only this time": one clip changes, plod v2 stays as it is
Scene 3: "the rabbit wakes up and dashes towards the tree"
A new behavior is composed; a guardrail makes the rabbit get up first
Too late: the turtle already won
Scene 4: the same gesture on the turtle, with NO words...
Fast path: recognized in 98 ms with no LLM call. Nap transfers to the turtle.
Harness learning: the LLM share falls; every self-change is listed with its reason
Play story: every clip is pinned to a behavior version
